cases.study_information: Predict the reported half-maximal concentration (nM; Table18 labels thisEC50) inhibiting membrane-bound humanTL1A-driven NF-kB-luciferase in TF1 cells cocultured with CHO-K1-TL1A for6h. It is a functional inhibition endpoint, notSPR KD. Antibody dilution covers100nM maximum with5-fold dilutions. Table11 monomer/trimerSPR and Table13 cell-binding values are visible; no-binding monomer control remains blank, notzero. Both analogue references retain their measured Table18 values. Two new antibodies are targets.
